To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
data mining is essentially the machine oriented data modeling, and that granular computing provides a natural framework for such machine oriented data modeling.

(i) Data mining is machine oriented modeling of data; (ii) The machine oriented model uses granules themselves as attributes; (iii) The granules are clusters of entities; (iv) The clusters are defined by binary relations.
the machine oriented data modeling and granular computing are the key concepts that can be exploited to achieve the goal of data mining.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: How to model data for efficient data storage, retrieval, and data mining?
the following issues: (1) Machine oriented database model; (2) Granular computing; (3) Data mining and machine oriented modeling; and (4) Machine calculus of granules.

a new paradigm of data modeling and mining, where the data are granulated (cluster) into granules, the granules themselves are used as attribute values in a model and data mining is a granular computing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the notion of granule is central to machine oriented data modeling, and data mining is machine oriented modeling.
data mining and machine oriented modeling are the same thing.
the granular computing approach is a natural way of modeling and mining data and knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a new approach to the data mining, which is based on a new data modeling.
we have provided an alternative approach to machine oriented data modeling and mining.
we have developed a granular computing framework to model and analyze data, and have applied it to the problems of data mining and machine oriented data modeling.
The main takeaway from our work is that
data mining and machine oriented modeling are essentially the same.
the machine can “understand” the data in a way that is similar to human understanding.
data mining is a granular computing problem.
